qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: #2-#3 positions in ostomy and advanced wound care face intense hospital GPO tenders and single-payer reimbursement ceilings, holding GAAP ROIC to 7-9%, far below leader Coloplast.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). While ConvaTec provides essential chronic-care supplies (ostomy, infusion sets, advanced wound care), it holds #2-#3 market positions behind Coloplast and Hollister. Sub-12% GAAP ROIC (~7-9%) and vulnerability to hospital GPO tenders and Medicare reimbursement pressure demonstrate inadequate pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: ConvaTec generated reported operating margins of 12.3% in 2023 and 14.2% in 2024 (adjusted margins ~20-21%), with historical GAAP ROIC hovering in the 7-9% range, well below the 12% threshold. Its ostomy and wound care segments face persistent reimbursement caps from European single-payers and US Medicare/GPO contract cycles, lacking the brand premium and margin insulation of market leader Coloplast.
